title: Nourishing Vietnamese Pork Cha Gio
description: A traditional Vietnamese dish featuring pork and vegetables wrapped in leaves and steamed, served with a pungent garlic sauce.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the ground pork, grated carrots, shredded cabbage, minced garlic, fish sauce, lime juice, salt, and black pepper, and mix well.
Lay a lettuce leaf flat on a comal and place about 1/4 cup of the pork mixture in the center of the leaf.
Fold the stem end of the leaf over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the leaf into a tight cylinder.
Repeat with the remaining leaves and filling.
Place the rolled leaves in a steamer basket, leaving some space between each leaf to allow for steam to pass through.
Steam the cha gio over boiling water for 10 minutes, or until the pork is cooked through and the leaves are tender.
While the cha gio are steaming, mix the minced garlic with 1 tablespoon of water to make the garlic sauce.
Serve the cha gio hot with the garlic sauce spooned over the top.
Garnish with chopped cilantro or scallions, if desired.
